place.name: Argos, Peloponnese
place.description: Argos (; Greek: Άργος [ˈarɣos]; Ancient: Ἄργος [árɡos]) is a city and a former municipality in the Peloponnese region of Greece, and one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world. It is the largest city in Argolis, having nearly twice the population of its capital, Nafplio.
